masterPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a visionary but realistic production-quality mobile UI design for NutriGuide, an adult daily wellness app whose distinctive feature connects how you feel with suitable ingredients, recipes and small daily routines.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. The user specifically LOVES the dark navy moonlit night-horizon "Uykuya hazırlık" card in the RIGHT phone. Extract its midnight blue, layered blue horizon, moonlight cream and calm spatial depth and elevate the ENTIRE app around that card. Do NOT preserve the surrounding old cream/orange UI. This is a substantial layout and visual-system redesign, not a dark-mode recolor.
Art direction: exceptionally polished next-generation native mobile app, restrained spatial depth, silky deep navy surfaces, soft edge light, sculptural food photography integrated into composition, editorial typography, elegant humane wellness. Moonlit palette: background #091B2B, layered surface #112D43, elevated #193B54, text #F2F5F4, secondary #ADC4D3, main actionable mint #B8E9D8 with dark navy labels, warm champagne #EAD5AE in tiny accents. Atmospheric abstract flowing horizon only in hero areas; keep body surfaces quiet. No orange, purple, neon cyberpunk, black-on-black low contrast, holographic gimmicks, excessive stars, medical scores, AI chatbot, or gratuitous floating glass rectangles. Content itself should generate the visual form: food bowl arcs, breathing rings, and day-path curves share the same gentle geometry.
Output: one landscape board ~1536x1024 with EXACTLY TWO flat front-facing thin framed mobile screens, 390x844 logical design dimensions, large readable Turkish UI. Board dark navy like the app; no real photographed phones or perspective. Spacious composition but screen content dominates. Top outside phones single small label "NUTRIGUIDE / YENİ GÖRSEL KİMLİK", understated headline "Günün ritmi, sana göre." Footer outside "Tasarım konsepti • Örnek içerik". All Turkish diacritics crisp. Logical font sizes 30-34 titles,16 body,12-14secondary. 48px touch targets,52pxprimary buttons. Keep header/nav/system bars correctly inside devices.
LEFT SCREEN HOME:
Status 9:41 white. Minimal wordmark NutriGuide in white, upper-right circular E avatar outlined in muted blue. Greeting "Günaydın, Ece" muted small.
Large editorial headline "Bugün,\nsenin ritminde." with elegant tight leading.
Directly beneath, an INTEGRATED fluid horizon ribbon (not boxed mini dashboard), glowing gentle curve and small contextual labels "Enerji · Düşük" and "Uyku · Orta", text link "Güncelle ↗". No numeric readiness score.
Main personalized nutrition feature is visually dominant: eyebrow "BUGÜNKÜ BESİNLERİN", title "Kendine iyi bir\ntabak hazırla." A large photoreal warm ceramic bowl of chickpea cooked bulgur tomato parsley arranged in lower-right of this spacious navy surface, integrated with asymmetric editorial layout, warm directional light. At left clearly readable small ingredient names "Nohut · Bulgur\nDomates"; small muted reason "15 dakikalık tercihine göre". Small outlined profile chip "Süt ürünü yok". Avoid art under text. Full width mint CTA "Besinlerimi keşfet →" at bottom of nutrition section.
Below title "Bugünün küçük adımları" with two clean understated horizontal rows separated by hairline: breathing icon "2 dk nefes molası" and tiny play circle; walking icon "10 dk kısa yürüyüş" and chevron. Not a stack of giant boxed cards.
Bottom integrated floating dark rounded navigation dock, subtly elevated above safe area, five icons and exact labels "Bugün", "Beslen", "Rutinler", "Gelişim", "Profil". Bugün selected mint with a small filled pill behind icon. All others soft blue. 5 icons identical geometric outline style.
RIGHT SCREEN DAILY CHECK-IN:
Back arrow top left, centered label "Günlük durum". Heading "Kendine\nbir an ayır." Subheading "Bugünkü planını birlikte şekillendirelim."
A subtle luminous blue horizon arc behind heading, no excessive visualization. Four sections in a refined airy stack with hairline separators, not generic white tiles:
"Ruh halin" with3 soft outlined selectable pills "Zorlanıyorum", "Dengeli", "İyi". Dengeli selected mint border + faint mint fill, tiny selected dot.
"Enerjin" choices "Düşük", "Orta", "Yüksek". Düşük selected.
"Uykun nasıldı?" choices "Zayıf", "Orta", "İyi". Orta selected.
"Öğün hazırlamak için" choices "15 dk", "30 dk", "Esneğim".15dk selected.
Only use simple monochrome icons; all unselected text legible muted ice blue. Under sections low-key outlined row "Başka bir durum ekle +".
Pinned full-width mint CTA "Bugünkü planımı hazırla →"; secondary centered text "Şimdilik atla". No bottom navigation in this focused subflow. Optional tiny text "Paylaşmak istemediklerini atlayabilirsin."
Overall: a beautiful calm future-facing product with real content and strong functional hierarchy. Must feel like a completely more sophisticated visual system than the previous reference while retaining its moonlit navy DNA. No compatibility percentages or medical promises.

followups.name: 01-gunluk-rehber-v2
followups.prompt: Edit the supplied exact NutriGuide dark navy two-screen concept. Make ONE targeted typography correction throughout the entire board: replace ALL serif lettering (wordmark, large headings, section headings and outer board headline) with beautiful contemporary geometric-humanist SANS SERIF. Use confident modern medium weight, subtly rounded precise forms, premium next-generation native app typography. Not monospaced, not sci-fi stencil, not childish. Keep ALL words EXACTLY unchanged, including Turkish diacritics. Preserve the complete composition, nighttime blue palette, flowing horizon, moon, food photo, buttons, controls, selected states, spacing, two phone frames, dock and all dimensions. Do not make any other design or content changes. Existing body sans-serif can remain. Result must feel modern and futuristic, not retro editorial.

Outside understated title "02 / Sana göre beslenme".
LEFT FOOD SCREEN, main Beslen selected. Status9:41, wordmark small then heading "Tabağına\niyi bir başlangıç." Muted context "15 dakikalık tercihine göre". Compact pills "Süt ürünü yok" and "Yemiş filtresi".
Refined two-part layout: a softly illuminated curved horizon behind heading flows into three stacked ingredient selection rows, each with a small photoreal ceramic ingredient bowl integrated on left, name and fact on right, small outlined "Değiştir". Show:
"Haşlanmış nohut" / "Mutfağında var" with subtle mint check
"Pişmiş bulgur" / "Mutfağında var" with subtle mint check
"Domates" / "Alışverişe ekle" small plus (do not confuse selection and inventory).
No bulky boxed borders; hairline separators and subtle surface gradients.
Below a small light-mark/icon with heading "Neden bu besinler?" and text "Hazır malzemelerinle pratik bir öğün. Baklagil, tahıl ve sebze bir arada."
Mint full-width CTA "Bu besinlerle tarif bul →". Bottom dock Beslen active.
RIGHT RECIPE focused screen status9:41, back arrow, small label "Senin için seçildi", bookmark. Headline "Nohutlu\nbulgur kasesi". A beautiful large oval ceramic plate seen overhead/three-quarter with cooked bulgur chickpeas tomato parsley, warm light and dark indigo table surroundings seamlessly merging into screen, no nuts/cheese. Photo does not dominate more than third of screen, leave functional room. Meta "15 dk · 1 porsiyon". Small line "Hazır nohut ve pişmiş bulgurla".
Integrated softly edged navy reason panel heading "Neden sana göre?" fact rows "Kısa hazırlık sürene uygun", "Süt ürünü kullanılmadı", "Seçtiğin besinleri birleştirir".
Accordion "Malzemeler ve miktarlar  ˅". Compact subtle note "Ürünlerin alerjen etiketlerini kontrol et."
Pinned mint CTA "Pişirmeye başla →". Tiny secondary link "Eksikleri alışverişe ekle". No bottom dock in recipe subflow.
Preserve appetizing warm food natural color, no fake calorie values, no medical claims.
